title: JSON Forms config — core and antd renderers
description: The `config` object handed to <JsonForms config={…}>, covering what JSON Forms core defines plus what the antd renderer set reads. For the options the extended renderer sets add, use jsonforms-extended-config.schema.json, which is a superset of this file. additionalProperties is true throughout: unknown options must be preserved and ignored, so a schema that rejected them would call a conformant document invalid.

restrict.description: Preventive UI constraints. Resolved from element options, then here, then true. Unrelated to any validator's strict mode.

hideRequiredAsterisk.description: Hides the visual required marker without changing required validation or accessible required state.

showUnfocusedDescription.description: Shows a control's description while it is not focused.

disableAdd.description: Prevents inserting array items, independently of array size. Cannot override read-only state or restrict prevention.

disableRemove.description: Prevents deleting array items, independently of array size.

enableFilterErrorsBeforeTouch.description: Suppresses control error text until the control is touched. Touch is blur, not focus. Presentation only: the form stays invalid.

filterErrorKeywordsBeforeTouch.description: Keywords to suppress before touch. With filtering enabled, an absent or empty array suppresses all control error text before touch.

dateSaveFormat.description: Stored format for date controls. Must stay compatible with the schema's own format.

views.description: Which panels the picker offers. Date views select the calendar's granularity; time views select which time columns are drawn. The finest date view named is where the calendar lands. It does not change the save format - a year/month picker storing a full date is a legitimate request, and asking for hours and minutes does not stop seconds being stored. An array naming no view of a kind the control uses leaves that half to the display format, rather than blanking it. As a global default this cannot be narrowed per control kind: the UI schema's own file constrains date, time and date-time separately.

trim.description: NOT IMPLEMENTED and excluded by the portable contract. An element carrying it draws a diagnostic; use options.layout.width or maxWidth instead. It is diagnosed rather than ignored because renderer families that do read it exist, so a ported UI schema will carry it.

separateReadonlyFromDisabled.description: NOT IMPLEMENTED here. With the compatibility default false, read-only sources participate in disabling controls.

dimension.description: A CSS length. A number is pixels; a string is passed through as authored.

extended.description: Portable project extensions: defined in the specification, not upstream. Per-element options stay flat; only this global bag is namespaced.

restrict.description: Namespaced spelling, read by temporal bound prevention. The top-level `restrict` is the documented location; this is read where an element option is absent.

collapsed.description: Default initial Group expansion. Ignored unless collapsible.

showDataIndicator.description: Default for the Group data-presence indicator.

showValidationIndicator.description: Default for the aggregated descendant-error indicator. Container defaults differ: arrays and item headers default true, Group and Category default false.

showValidationIndicatorCount.description: False shows the marker without a number and skips computing one.

confirmationPolicy.description: always confirms against any existing value; never skips the prompt; complex confirms only when the discarded value is a non-empty object or array.

confirmation.description: Destructive-change confirmation. Separate from mutation permission: it never grants what read-only or restrict forbid.

renderers.description: Per-catalog overrides, keyed by stable semantic catalog id.

layoutDefaults.description: Defaults for layout containers. An explicit option on the element still wins.

gap.description: Default gap between a layout's children. Direction-dependent by design: a non-zero row gutter, because two controls placed side by side would otherwise share an edge, and zero for a column, because controls that already carry a bottom margin would be double-spaced. An explicit gap on the element still wins, and 0 restores edge-sharing at either level.

minItemWidth.description: Parent default minimum for children. Auto-fit requires wrap.
